# ci/shellcheck-baseline.txt
# ShellCheck ratchet baseline for scripts/**/*.sh.
#
# Format: <file>  <SCcode>  <count>
#   - count = number of times SCcode fires in that file at the time of this
#     baseline (generated by shellcheck 0.10.0 at -S style, see ci/shellcheck.sh
#     and .github/workflows/ci.yml).
#   - The ratchet FAILs when a pair fires MORE often than the count, or when
#     a pair fires that is not here at all. Shrinking counts or deleting
#     pairs is always allowed — the tree can only get cleaner.
#   - To regenerate after legitimate changes:
#       set PATH to the pinned shellcheck (see ci.yml) and run:
#         cd <root>
#         find scripts -type f -name '*.sh' | xargs shellcheck -S style -f gcc 2>&1 \
#           | sed -E 's|^([^:]+):[0-9]+:[0-9]+:.*\[(SC[0-9]+)\]$|\1\t\2|' \
#           | grep -E $'\tSC[0-9]+' | sort \
#           | awk -F'\t' '{ c[$1 "\t" $2]++ } END { for (k in c) printf "%s\t%d\n", k, c[k] }' | sort > /tmp/base.txt
#         cat /tmp/base.txt
#       (review each new pair, confirm the code is intentional, then commit)
#
# Generated on v0.17.0 (e0b75075) with shellcheck 0.10.0 — see the pinned
# tarball sha256 in .github/workflows/ci.yml.
